title: 10 Shots: Federal Agents Kill Another Person in Minnesota

sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空中长达七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我要测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60个超级圣代。

sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，致力于帮助您理解世界，充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅即可享受特别优惠，访问 nytimes.com 斜杠 subscribe。

sentences.en: A warning that this episode contains descriptions of violence and graphic language.
sentences.zh: 警告：本期节目包含暴力描写和粗俗语言。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是雷切尔·艾布拉姆斯，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Outrage and protests in Minneapolis after federal agents shoot and kill a man today.
sentences.zh: 今天，联邦特工开枪打死一名男子后，明尼阿波利斯市爆发愤怒与抗议。

sentences.en: Border patrol agents shot and killed a man in Minneapolis on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 周六，边境巡逻队特工在明尼阿波利斯开枪打死了一名男子。

sentences.en: The second fatal clash between federal authorities and protesters in less than a month.
sentences.zh: 这是不到一个月内联邦当局与抗议者发生的第二起致命冲突。

sentences.en: Eyewitness video shows once again reckless, violent, and dangerous federal agents taking the life of a Minnesotan.
sentences.zh: 目击者视频再次显示，鲁莽、暴力且危险的联邦特工夺去了明尼苏达州人的生命。

sentences.en: If it can happen here, it can happen in your community too.
sentences.zh: 如果这种事会在这里发生，它也可能在你的社区发生。

sentences.en: The shooting prompted a fresh wave of fury and condemnation across the country.
sentences.zh: 这起枪击事件在全国范围内引发了新一波的愤怒与谴责。

sentences.en: How many more Americans need to die or get badly hurt for this operation to end?
sentences.zh: 还要有多少美国人死亡或重伤，这次行动才能结束？

sentences.en: And it horrified residents in the city that has been revolting against a federal government crackdown on immigration.
sentences.zh: 它震惊了这座城市的居民，该市一直在抗议联邦政府对移民的镇压。

sentences.en: This individual who came with weapons and ammunition to stop a law enforcement operation of federal law enforcement officers committed an act of domestic terrorism.
sentences.zh: 这个携带武器和弹药来阻止联邦执法人员执法行动的个人，犯下了国内恐怖主义行为。

sentences.en: That's the facts.
sentences.zh: 这就是事实。

sentences.en: No one who wants to be peaceful shows up at a protest with a firearm that is loaded with two full magazines.
sentences.zh: 任何想要和平的人都不会带着装满两个弹匣的枪支出现在抗议活动中。

sentences.en: That is not a peaceful protest, and you do not get to touch law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 那不是和平抗议，你们无权触碰执法人员。

sentences.en: Federal officials allege that the protester was the aggressor and that the agents acted in self-defense.
sentences.zh: 联邦官员声称，抗议者是挑起事端者，特工们的行为属于正当防卫。

sentences.en: Oh, my God!
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪！

sentences.en: Oh, they just saw somebody.
sentences.zh: 哦，他们刚刚看到了某个人。

sentences.en: There we go!
sentences.zh: 我们走！

sentences.en: But videos of the shooting directly contradict that claim.
sentences.zh: 但枪击视频直接反驳了这一说法。

sentences.en: Today, we talk to our colleagues Devin Lum and Ernesto Londoño about how the shooting unfolded and what may come next.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们与同事德文·拉姆和埃尔内斯托·隆多尼奥一起讨论枪击事件是如何发生的以及接下来可能会发生什么。

sentences.en: It's Monday, January 26th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月26日，星期一。

sentences.en: Devin, welcome to The Daily.
sentences.zh: 德文，欢迎来到《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: So, Devin, by now I think a lot of people have seen this really graphic footage of a man named Alex Preddy getting shot by federal agents in Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 那么，德文，到目前为止，我想很多人都看到了这段非常清晰的录像，记录了一名叫亚历克斯·普雷迪的男子在明尼苏达州被联邦特工枪击的过程。

sentences.en: The Department of Homeland Security claims that Preddy was approaching these agents with a handgun that he was intent on committing what they called, quote, a massacre.
sentences.zh: 国土安全局声称，普雷迪手持手枪接近这些特工，意图实施他们所谓的、引述一下，“大屠杀”。

sentences.en: You are a member of our visual investigations team, which means that you have been spending a lot of time analyzing footage from this shooting, from the scene.
sentences.zh: 你是我们视觉调查团队的成员，这意味着你花了大量时间分析这次枪击现场的录像。

sentences.en: So, what do you make of the government's claims?
sentences.zh: 那么，你对政府的说法有什么看法？

sentences.en: We've been analyzing footage from various different angles over the past day and a half, trying to better understand what took place before, during, and after the shooting.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一天半里，我们一直在分析来自不同角度的录像，试图更好地了解枪击发生前、发生时以及发生后所发生的事情。

sentences.en: You know, there's contention over what happened between the federal government and the state government.
sentences.zh: 你知道，联邦政府和州政府之间对发生的事情存在争议。

sentences.en: And we're doing our best to resolve that contention by walking through the visual evidence as clearly and as in-depth as we possibly can.
sentences.zh: 我们正在尽最大努力，尽可能清晰、深入地梳理视觉证据，以解决这种争议。

sentences.en: And the one thing that's blatantly clear in our analysis that contrasts with the narrative that the administration put out there in the immediate aftermath of the shooting
sentences.zh: 在我们的分析中，有一点是显而易见的，这与政府在枪击事件发生后立即发布的说法形成了鲜明对比：

sentences.en: is that Preddy was not holding a gun when he began interacting with the federal agents or throughout the entirety of their interaction.
sentences.zh: 那就是普雷迪在开始与联邦特工互动时，或者在他们互动的整个过程中，并没有拿着枪。

sentences.en: Instead, he's holding a cell phone.
sentences.zh: 相反，他拿着一部手机。

sentences.en: And can you just set the scene, Devin, at the beginning of the footage that you've been analyzing?
sentences.zh: 德文，你能否介绍一下你一直在分析的录像开始时的场景？

sentences.en: What do we see?
sentences.zh: 我们看到了什么？

sentences.en: What's going on?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: The footage begins with two protesters interacting with the federal agent on a street in Minneapolis in front of a donut shop.
sentences.zh: 录像开始时，两名抗议者正在明尼阿波利斯一条街道上、一家甜甜圈店前与一名联邦特工互动。

sentences.en: We can see that Preddy is walking into the street with his outstretched arm, holding his cell phone, recording the interaction.
sentences.zh: 我们可以看到普雷迪伸出胳膊走上街头，手里拿着手机，正在录制互动过程。

sentences.en: He appears to be an observer in this moment.
sentences.zh: 此刻他似乎是一个旁观者。

sentences.en: He's standing, you know, further away from where that interaction is taking place and appears to be directing traffic with his free hand.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他站在距离互动发生地点较远的地方，并似乎正用空着的手指挥交通。

sentences.en: And how do things escalate from there?
sentences.zh: 事情是从那里如何升级的？

sentences.en: The agent who is interacting with the two protesters standing in the street begins to push the protesters in the direction of Mr. Preddy.
sentences.zh: 正在街上与两名抗议者互动的特工开始将抗议者朝普雷迪先生的方向推去。

sentences.en: And eventually they make their way towards where he's standing.
sentences.zh: 最终他们来到了他站立的地方。

sentences.en: So before I get into the details,
sentences.zh: 所以在进入细节之前，

sentences.en: I just want to say that these next moments happen very quickly.
sentences.zh: 我只想说，接下来的这些时刻发生得非常快。

sentences.en: From the time that things started to escalate until the final shot is fired, just over 40 seconds elapsed.
sentences.zh: 从事情开始升级到射出最后一枪，仅仅过去了40多秒。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Once they get there, the agent pushes one of the protesters to the ground.
sentences.zh: 他们到那里后，特工将其中一名抗议者推倒在地。

sentences.en: And Alex Preddy steps in between the agent and the woman who has just been pushed to the ground.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·普雷迪介入了该特工和刚被推倒在地的女性之间。

sentences.en: The agent begins firing pepper spray at him.
sentences.zh: 特工开始向他喷射胡椒喷雾。

sentences.en: In that moment, we can see that he's still holding his cell phone.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，我们可以看到他手里仍然拿着手机。

sentences.en: And his other hand is still free.
sentences.zh: 他的另一只手仍然是空着的。

sentences.en: Then Alex Preddy turns around to apparently try to help the woman who's been pushed to the ground up to her feet.
sentences.zh: 然后亚历克斯·普雷迪转过身，显然是试图扶起被推倒在地的女性。

sentences.en: And the agent continues firing pepper spray at both of them.
sentences.zh: 而特工继续向他们两人喷射胡椒喷雾。

sentences.en: Several agents appear behind Mr. Preddy and begin pulling him in order to get him down to the ground.
sentences.zh: 几名特工出现在普雷迪先生身后，开始拉扯他，试图把他按倒在地。

sentences.en: Once he's down on the ground, several other agents are holding him down.
sentences.zh: 他倒地后，其他几名特工把他按在地上。

sentences.en: They're grabbing at his legs.
sentences.zh: 他们抓着他的腿。

sentences.en: They're pushing him in his back.
sentences.zh: 他们推他的背。

sentences.en: And they appear to be striking him repetitively.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎在反复击打他。

sentences.en: Another agent walks towards the scrum
sentences.zh: 另一名特工走向混战人群，

sentences.en: and reaches toward Alex Preddy with open hands.
sentences.zh: 双手空空地走向亚历克斯·普雷迪。

sentences.en: It's unclear at that moment why he's grabbing at him.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚他当时为什么要抓他。

sentences.en: But a few seconds later, we hear someone saying he's got a gun over and over again.
sentences.zh: 但几秒钟后，我们听到有人一遍又一遍地喊着他有枪。

sentences.en: They say it repetitively.
sentences.zh: 他们反复说着这句话。

sentences.en: Meaning that they might not have realized that he had a gun until that moment when he's on the ground.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们可能直到他倒地的那一刻才意识到他有枪。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And again, looking back at the footage, from any point of the interaction up until now, there is no visual giveaway that would indicate that agents knew that he was armed.
sentences.zh: 再次回顾录像，从互动的任何阶段直到现在，都没有任何视觉迹象表明特工知道他有武装。

sentences.en: So what happens next?
sentences.zh: 那么接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: How does the scene unfold from there once he's restrained and on the ground?
sentences.zh: 一旦他被制服并倒在地上，现场是如何演变的？

sentences.en: The agent who reached into the scrum with open hands grabs a firearm from Alex Preddy's waiSt.
sentences.zh: 那个空手介入混战的特工从亚历克斯·普雷迪的腰间抓起了一把枪。

sentences.en: Then, about one second after Preddy's gun has been removed, another agent fires the first shot.
sentences.zh: 然后，在普雷迪的枪被拿走大约一秒钟后，另一名特工开了第一枪。

sentences.en: So he can see the other agent taking the gun out of the holster.
sentences.zh: 所以可以看到另一个特工把枪从枪套里拿出来。

sentences.en: We're not exactly sure what he's seeing at this point because it's a very split second.
sentences.zh: 我们不太确定他此时看到了什么，因为这是一个极短的瞬间。

sentences.en: But in the video, it appears he has a clear vantage point of the disarming as it's happening.
sentences.zh: 但在视频中，当解除武装的过程发生时，他似乎有一个清晰的视线。

sentences.en: So at this point, just to be clear, one agent has removed the gun, has backed away from Alex Preddy, and that's when we hear the first shot that was fired.
sentences.zh: 所以为了明确起见，此时一名特工已经拿走了枪，并退开了亚历克斯·普雷迪，然后我们听到了第一声枪响。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The gun that was apparently removed from Alex Preddy's hip is away from the pile before the first shot is fired.
sentences.zh: 显然是从亚历克斯·普雷迪臀部取下的枪，在开第一枪之前就已经被拿离了那堆人。

sentences.en: And after that first shot is fired, Preddy appears to get up onto his knees, and his hands, which were bunched up near his head, move down towards his sides.
sentences.zh: 在开第一枪后，普雷迪似乎撑着膝盖和双手站了起来，他原本蜷缩在头部附近的双手向下移动到身体两侧。

sentences.en: The agent fires three more times, and Preddy begins to fall to the ground.
sentences.zh: 特工又开了三枪，普雷迪开始倒地。

sentences.en: He reaches down with his left hand while falling, apparently to brace himself, and there does not appear to be weapons in either of his hands.
sentences.zh: 他在下落时用左手向下伸，显然是为了稳住自己，他的双手似乎都没有武器。

sentences.en: Then, the agent who initially pepper-sprayed Preddy joins in, and the two of them fire six more shots at Preddy's disarmed body,
sentences.zh: 然后，最初向普雷迪喷射胡椒喷雾的特工加入了进来，两人向已经解除武装的普雷迪的身体又开了六枪，

sentences.en: which is at this point laying motionless on the ground.
sentences.zh: 此时他的身体一动不动地躺在地上。

sentences.en: In total, they appear to fire ten shots in five seconds.
sentences.zh: 总共，他们似乎在五秒钟内开了十枪。

sentences.en: We can hear in later footage that as agents are searching Alex Preddy's body after he's already been shot, one agent yells, where's the gun?
sentences.zh: 从后来的录像中我们可以听到，当特工在普雷迪已经中枪后搜查他的身体时，一名特工大喊：枪在哪儿？

sentences.en: Where's the gun?
sentences.zh: 枪在哪儿？

sentences.en: So, clearly not all of the agents know that Alex Preddy had already been disarmed.
sentences.zh: 显然，并非所有的特工都知道亚历克斯·普雷迪已经被解除武装。

sentences.en: You know, given the fact that the first shot was fired only about a second after Preddy's gun was removed,
sentences.zh: 你知道，鉴于第一枪是在普雷迪的枪被取走仅一秒钟后开出的，

sentences.en: even though the agent who shot Alex Preddy might have been able to see that the gun had been unholstered,
sentences.zh: 尽管开枪打死亚历克斯·普雷迪的特工可能已经看到枪已被拔出，

sentences.en: it all is happening so fast that you can't know for sure whether he definitely knew that when he was firing.
sentences.zh: 但这一切发生得太快了，你无法确定他在开枪时是否绝对知道这一点。

sentences.en: Well, sure, it's difficult to know what the agent who fired saw or knew when he fired, other than that there was a gun present.
sentences.zh: 当然，除了知道现场有一把枪之外，很难知道开枪的特工在开枪时看到了什么或知道了什么。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: But what we do know is that Alex Preddy was very clearly subdued on the ground.
sentences.zh: 但我们所知道的是，亚历克斯·普雷迪当时非常明显地被制服在地上。

sentences.en: He was being held down, and his arms were by his head.
sentences.zh: 他被按在地上，双臂放在头部旁边。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And, again, the agent was standing behind Preddy.
sentences.zh: 而且，特工当时是站在普雷迪身后的。

sentences.en: He was aiming at his back.
sentences.zh: 他瞄准的是他的后背。

sentences.en: So, he presented no clear threat to the agents at that point.
sentences.zh: 因此，在那一刻，他对特工们没有构成明确的威胁。

sentences.en: But I want to stress that the statement that is being made by the Department of Homeland Security is that Preddy approached an agent with a gun.
sentences.zh: 但我想强调的是，国土安全局发表的声明是，普雷迪持枪接近了一名特工。

sentences.en: It's true, he was armed with a gun, but the videos show he was not holding it in his hand throughout the entire interaction with the agents.
sentences.zh: 没错，他确实带着枪，但视频显示，在与特工互动的整个过程中，他并没有把它拿在手里。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: The Department of Homeland Security also said the agent fired out of concern for the agent's safety.
sentences.zh: 国土安全局还表示，特工开枪是出于对特工自身安全的担忧。

sentences.en: So, if we're looking at the footage and we're assessing whether or not there's a concern for safety, we can see that Preddy is on the ground, he's being subdued,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果我们查看录像并评估是否存在安全担忧，我们可以看到普雷迪倒在地上，正在被制服，

sentences.en: and even if there's a gun on his hip, at one point, he can't reach it.
sentences.zh: 即使他的臀部有一把枪，在某个时刻，他也够不到它。

sentences.en: So, the response to shoot him, to pull out a firearm, and shoot him rather than taking a beat to understand whether another agent,
sentences.zh: 因此，开枪射击他的反应——拔出枪支并开枪，而不是花点时间弄清楚另一名特工、

sentences.en: one of your colleagues, has disarmed the person you're about to shoot,
sentences.zh: 你的同事，是否已经解除了你即将射击的那个人的武装，

sentences.en: it just doesn't comport with what the Department of Homeland Security is saying.
sentences.zh: 这根本与国土安全局的说法不符。

sentences.en: You know, we talked to our colleague Charles Homans on the show about a week ago.
sentences.zh: 你知道，大约一周前，我们在节目中与我们的同事查尔斯·霍曼斯进行了交谈。

sentences.en: He described at that point what felt almost like a lull, in the sense that it had been a few days since a federal agent had shot Renee Good.
sentences.zh: 他当时形容了一种几乎是平静的感觉，因为距离联邦特工枪击蕾妮·古德已经过去了几天。

sentences.en: Obviously, people had taken to the streets, were outraged, but it felt also like ICE was operating a little bit less visibly,
sentences.zh: 显然，人们走上街头，感到愤怒，但也感觉移民和海关执法局（ICE）的行动没有那么显眼，

sentences.en: and I think it was kind of an open question at that time whether things would escalate or would de-escalate.
sentences.zh: 我认为当时这是一个悬而未决的问题，即局势会升级还是会缓和。

sentences.en: And it feels really notable that here we are, just a few days later, reacting to another fatal shooting.
sentences.zh: 而现在仅仅几天后，我们就对又一起致命枪击事件作出反应，这让人觉得非常引人注目。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: This is the second shooting in less than a month that's been carried out by federal agents in Minneapolis,
sentences.zh: 这是不到一个月内在明尼阿波利斯发生的第二起由联邦特工实施的枪击事件，

sentences.en: where the footage that we've analyzed has conflicted with statements that have been made by the Department of Homeland Security about what took place.
sentences.zh: 我们分析的录像与国土安全局关于发生事情的声明存在矛盾。

sentences.en: Tensions are already high online, around the country, and on the ground.
sentences.zh: 网络上、全国各地以及现场的紧张局势已经很高了。

sentences.en: And this is sure to inflame them further.
sentences.zh: 这肯定会进一步加剧紧张局势。

sentences.en: Devin Lum, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 德文·拉姆，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
